scope: Finite simulation of the signed32 raw-activation/signed24 learned-gain reader and its wide normalization wrapper. This is a row unit, not a frame or complete-model result.

implementation.memory_interface: One outstanding burst; each statistics/replay strip reads four 64-bit raw beats and three 64-bit packed-gain beats.
implementation.storage: One reader strip buffer and one registered wrapper output skid; no full raw-row buffer.
implementation.fault_handling: Preserves offered transfers under backpressure; drains owned reads on ordinary faults, quarantines ambiguous responses, and resets the private core only after external obligations are settled.

simulation.coverage: Healthy rows, address limits, invalid configurations, backpressure, aborts, malformed burst termination, response faults, quarantine, held completion, replay mismatch, and sampled live-phase coupled resets.
simulation.test_data: The testbench reads twelve local .hex fixtures through +RAW32_ROOT. Data and learned gains remain in project .cache and are not included in Git.

verification.attempt1_limitation: Two resets occurred before the intended held transfer was sampled. Attempt2 adds two testbench wait clocks for those phases; production logic and checker predicates are unchanged.

limitations.technology: The project targets a TSMC 28 nm adaptation; this unit simulation makes no silicon process, area, timing or energy claim.
